claims.title: Retained interconnect state: private metal stocks, dielectric routing and opposed gas

quoted_fields.interface: Sixteen-terminal complete graph with120 private cells and star routing, introduced on resistance/off conductance/capacitance and terminal loads. Two separately sealed opposing gas stocks form a different pressure organization from the single-pocket screen; outer ambient-force surfaces and total flexible-wall stiffness must be physically supplied.
quoted_fields.failure: Circuit linearity and no extra conducting paths are hypotheses. Thermal cancellation at zero displacement does not cancel differential temperatures, fill/volume errors, gas loss or nonzero-displacement spring force. Thermal bridges carry their particular electrical topology and capacitance.
